verdict.rationale: MoonPay provides extensive first-party documentation for a fiat-to-crypto onramp/offramp, including hosted widgets, headless Web SDK, session/quote APIs, webhooks, guest checkout, and card/Apple Pay/Google Pay/bank transfer support, plus demo integration repos and sandbox/test mode for developers to embed in their product. Missing for 10: docs are framed generically as 'fiat-to-crypto' rather than stablecoin-specific, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of the integration actually working end-to-end.
